candidate.answerReason: The three positions are containment, parallelism with no common points, and intersection at exactly one point.

methods.label: Line-plane position classification
methods.explanation: A line either lies in the plane, is parallel to the plane, or intersects the plane. Skew is a relationship between two lines.
methods.levelReason: The classification and the distinction from skew lines are elementary concepts within the stated curriculum.

review.mathematicalCheck: A line and plane have no common points, exactly one, or the entire line in common; two distinct common points imply containment. These give the three positions in A. Skew describes two lines.
review.levelCheck: The classification and skew-line distinction are appropriate elementary spatial geometry.
